prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP server's JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' — the current check requires both 'application/json' AND 'text/event-stream' to be present, even though JSON response mode never streams SSE. prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP server's JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' — the current check requires both 'application/json' AND 'text/event-stream' to be present, even though JSON response mode never streams SSE. Both PRs touch the exact same validation block in src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts (the Accept-header check around the POST handler) and both changesets describe the identical fix: allow JSON-only Accept headers in JSON response mode. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 replaces the Accept check with a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that splits on ',' and ';', normalizes case/whitespace, and explicitly excludes entries with q=0 and matches type/subtype (including wildcards). 2046's fix keeps the original plain `.includes('application/json')` substring style, which does not account for a quality-value of 0 (e.g. `Accept: application/json;q=0, text/event-stream` would be misread as accepting JSON) or wildcard media ranges. Both diffs are similar in size, but 1996's approach covers more real Accept-header edge cases with the same single-file change.
